title: Privacy Policy
intro: This policy explains what personal data HRVN s.r.o. processes when you visit hivepal.app, create an account or use Hive Pal, and what rights you have.
operator: We process personal data in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (the GDPR) and Slovak Act No. 18/2018 Coll. on the protection of personal data, as amended. The operator of this website is HRVN s.r.o.

controller.title: Controller and contact
controller.content: The controller of your personal data is HRVN s.r.o. For any question about this policy, to exercise your rights or to object to processing, write to info@hivepal.app.

dataProtection.title: What we process and why
dataProtection.content: We process only the data each purpose needs, and only for as long as it is needed. The legal basis for each purpose is given in brackets.

account.title: Account and application data
account.content: When you register we process your name, email address, a hash of your password and the apiaries, hives, inspections, harvests and other records you enter. We use this data to provide the service you asked for and to secure your account (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).

uploads.title: Photos, documents and voice notes
uploads.content: Photos, documents and voice notes you upload are kept in our file storage and are visible only to you and to people you share the apiary with. Camera photos often carry embedded metadata, including the GPS position where they were taken. Before storing a JPEG, PNG or WebP image we remove that metadata (EXIF, XMP, IPTC); HEIC photos are currently stored as uploaded (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).

signIn.title: Signing in with Google or Facebook
signIn.content: If you choose to sign in with Google or Facebook, that provider confirms your identity and sends us your name, email address and account identifier; we do not receive your password or any other data from that account. The provider learns that you signed in to Hive Pal and processes this under its own privacy policy. We use the data to create and secure your account (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).

analytics.title: Website analytics
analytics.content: We measure how the public site and the application are used with Umami, which we run on our own infrastructure at umami.hrvn.eu. Its tracker sets no cookie and writes nothing to your device. It sends the page address, the referring page, your browser language, screen size and a short-lived session identifier derived from a salted hash of your IP address and user agent; the raw IP address is not stored. We use this to see which pages are used and to improve them (legitimate interest, Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). You can object at any time — see "Analytics and your choice".

monitoring.title: Error and performance monitoring
monitoring.content: We use Sentry for error reports and Grafana Faro to measure page speed. They record technical information about a failing request or a slow page: the error message and stack trace, the page address, browser and device type and the time. Neither sets a cookie. We use them to find and fix defects and to keep the application fast (legitimate interest, Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

newsletter.title: Product updates
newsletter.content: If you ticked the newsletter box during registration or in your account, we use your email address to send occasional product updates and beekeeping tips. This is based on your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), which you can withdraw at any time in your account settings or through the unsubscribe link in every email.

logs.title: Server logs and security
logs.content: Our servers keep short-lived technical logs (IP address, time, requested address, response status) to operate the service, diagnose faults and defend against abuse (legitimate interest, Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

cookies.title: Cookies and device storage
cookies.content: We do not use advertising, profiling or cross-site tracking cookies. Nothing non-essential is stored on your device, which is why you see no cookie consent banner. What we do store:
cookies.session: A session cookie once you sign in, so the server knows you are logged in. It is strictly necessary (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) and is removed when you sign out or it expires.
cookies.ui: A sidebar_state cookie that remembers whether the navigation sidebar is collapsed. It is a functional preference and never leaves the application.
cookies.preferences: Your theme and interface language in your browser's local storage, so the site opens the way you left it. These preferences stay on your device.
cookies.noThirdParties: We do not load advertising networks, social plugins, embedded trackers or third-party web fonts. Web fonts and application assets are served from hivepal.app; the analytics and error-monitoring services described above are the only external services involved.

analyticsChoice.title: Analytics and your choice
analyticsChoice.content: Analytics is based on our legitimate interest, so you have the right to object. Switch it off below: the tracker stops sending data immediately and the setting is stored in this browser only. Turning analytics off does not affect your account or the service.
analyticsChoice.note: The choice is saved in this browser only. Clearing site data turns analytics back on.

retention.title: How long we keep data
retention.content: Account and application data is kept while your account exists and is deleted or anonymised when you delete it, unless the law requires us to keep it longer. Analytics and monitoring records are kept only for as long as needed to evaluate them and are then deleted in the normal course of running those systems. Server logs are rotated regularly and kept only briefly.

recipients.title: Who we share data with
recipients.content: We do not sell personal data. We share it only with processors that help us run the service — hosting, error monitoring and email delivery — under data-processing agreements and only for the purposes above. Where a processor handles data outside the EEA, the transfer relies on an adequacy decision or the EU Standard Contractual Clauses. Public authorities receive data only where the law requires it.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.content: You have the right to access your data, to have it corrected, deleted or restricted, to receive it in a portable format, to object to processing based on legitimate interest (including analytics) and to withdraw consent at any time without affecting processing already carried out. Write to info@hivepal.app and we will answer within one month.
rights.complaint: If you believe we have handled your data unlawfully, you can complain to the Slovak supervisory authority: Úrad na ochranu osobných údajov Slovenskej republiky, Hraničná 12, 820 07 Bratislava 27, dataprotection.gov.sk.

children.title: Children
children.content: Hive Pal is not intended for children. You must be at least 16 years old to create an account. If you believe a child under 16 has given us personal data, write to info@hivepal.app and we will delete it.

security.title: Security
security.content: We apply technical and organisational measures to protect personal data against loss, alteration and unauthorised access, and review them regularly.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.content: We update this policy when what we do changes. The date below shows the last revision.

deletion.title: Deleting Your Data
deletion.content: You can delete your account and all your data at any time, either in the app or by sending us a request.

illegalContent.title: Reporting illegal content
illegalContent.content: Content you upload is private to your apiaries and is not published. If you nevertheless come across content in Hive Pal that you believe is illegal — for example through a share link — report it to info@hivepal.app, the single point of contact under the EU Digital Services Act. Tell us where the content is and why you believe it is illegal; we will review the report, act on it without undue delay and let you know the outcome. Authorities can use the same address, in English or Slovak.

contact.title: Contact
contact.content: For any question about the protection of personal data, contact us at:

dataDeletion.title: Data Deletion
dataDeletion.intro: You can delete your Hive Pal account and all data associated with it at any time. This includes the data we received when you signed in with Facebook or Google: your name, email address and account identifier.

inApp.title: Delete your account in the app
inApp.content: Sign in, open Settings and choose “{{action}}”. Your account and all data you own (apiaries, hives, inspections, photos and linked sign-in accounts) are deleted immediately and cannot be restored.

byEmail.title: Request deletion by email
byEmail.content: If you can no longer sign in, send a deletion request to
byEmail.details: Send it from the email address of your Hive Pal account, or tell us which address the account uses. We delete the account and all associated data within 30 days and confirm by email.

facebook.title: Removing Hive Pal from Facebook
facebook.content: On Facebook you can also remove Hive Pal under Settings & privacy → Settings → Apps and websites. This stops Facebook from sharing data with Hive Pal, but does not delete your Hive Pal account. Use one of the options above for that.

meta.title: Data Deletion - Hive Pal
meta.description: How to delete your Hive Pal account and the data associated with it, including data from Facebook or Google sign-in.

meta.title: Privacy Policy - Hive Pal
meta.description: Read the Hive Pal privacy policy to understand how we collect, use, and protect your personal data.
